scope: Local diagnostic thresholds only; no production SLA/SLO or deployed alert manager
window: Inspect 5-minute deltas; latency warnings only with >=20 observations per pipeline; no-traffic is unknown, not healthy

basis.fallback_and_error: Phase6 formal 23040 requests had zero of each; intentional integration faults are explained exceptions
basis.readiness: DEGRADED is searchable (HTTP200) but should still trigger investigation
basis.queue: Phase7 natural C1 direct queue P95 is 0.030/0.034/0.042 ms in 12 requests per mode; 5ms is a coarse substantial increase and material relative to 10-20ms core inference. Small sample is diagnostic only
basis.request: Round ~3x Phase6 max C1 client RTT P95 (3.21/14.66/19.31ms) upward to 10/50/60ms. Server ASGI lifetime differs from client RTT; this is a conservative local proxy, not a calibrated capacity limit
basis.phase6_residual: server_non_engine_ms is NOT an exact queue measure and was not used as a queue baseline
basis.histograms: Prometheus histogram P95 is bucket-interpolated; use exact local observations when diagnosing borderline warnings
